transcript.text: Hi everyone. Before I publish the December holiday on-call roster, I need to run through the holiday-readiness process. We need to confirm coverage for December 24, 25, and 26. The draft has Riley as primary and Casey as secondary for all three days, with a 30-minute escalation target. I need SRE, payments engineering, customer support, and security to each read back their coverage and flag any exceptions. Please go ahead and share your status.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception: my approved leave covers December 25, so I cannot be primary or secondary on-call that day. I confirmed the leave while handling a separate HR scheduling task, but the roster spreadsheet hasn't been updated to reflect it.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception for payments engineering. The payments service's enterprise response agreement requires a named payments engineer to acknowledge a production alert within exactly 10 minutes on all three dates — December 24, 25, and 26 — rather than the draft's 30-minute escalation target. I confirmed this clause with account operations this morning but haven't updated the on-call ticket yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception for customer support. The customer Meridian has a contractual requirement for a support liaison to contact its administrators during any December 26 production incident, so I must be named as the December 26 customer liaison. I found this in an account-notes review yesterday, but the holiday handoff document still has the default unassigned value.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception for security. A certificate rotation for the production identity service is scheduled for December 26 from 21:00 to 23:00, and it requires me (Jordan) as the security escalation contact and the sole secondary on-call for December 26. I confirmed the timing during a certificate inventory, but the change ticket has not yet been linked to the holiday roster. Under the holiday-readiness replacement rule, since Riley is being removed from December 26's primary slot, Casey would be promoted to primary — and under the scheduled-operation rule, I would replace the draft secondary for the entire December 26 date, making me the sole secondary on-call for that day.
transcript.speaker: A5
